title: fix(app-shell): Studio's Automations, App and Data creates refuse an identifier a published or draft item already holds
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbQ45wNg97BSRszX9MTov2am)_

Fixes #26917

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio 的「新建自动化」「创建应用」「新建对象」在写入前,先查同类型已发布和草稿中的同名项(跨所有软件包);标识已被占用就拒绝、不写入,提示里点名占用者;占用者在本支柱左栏里(本软件包的流程或对象)时给出「打开它」。三处与「访问」页共用一个检查函数。
- **为什么改**:首写保护(`If-None-Match: *` + 草稿模式)只拦已有草稿,不拦已发布的同名项。实测(见下)三种类型都会在已发布项上叠一份空白草稿,发布软件包就会用空白项替换线上的流程、应用或对象。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只改 `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的三个新建回调与对话框,沿用现有接口(列表、草稿列表);服务端、spec 不动。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`findTakenIdentifier` 与 `CreateTakenNotice`(文件上部),`doCreateFlow` / `doCreateApp` / `doCreateObject` 开头的占用检查;`StudioDesignSurface.createTaken-26917.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.createTaken-26917.test.tsx`,预期 8 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **One shared check.** `findTakenIdentifier(client, type, name, locale)` reads the published items and the draft headers of a type across every package (`client.list(type)`, `client.listDrafts({ type })`, the unscoped pair the Interfaces and Access creates read) and names the item holding the identifier, or `null`. `CreateTakenNotice` renders the refusal in the create dialog: a sentence naming the holder and, when the holder is on the pillar's own rail, an "Open “LABEL”" button. The Access create (#26916) now uses both instead of its inline copy; its behaviour, sentences and test ids are unchanged.
- **New automation** (`doCreateFlow`): an identifier a flow holds is refused before anything is written. A flow on this package's rail gets "Open", which closes the dialog and opens it (the New button already asked about a held step, #26927, so Open asks nothing more); a flow another package holds gets no open path.
- **New object** (`doCreateObject`): the rail check it had (same package only) becomes the "here" arm of the same refusal, with "Open"; an object another package holds (the namespace-prefixed identifier) is now refused too.
- **Create app** (`doCreateApp`): an identifier an app holds is refused. Create app is offered only to a package with no app, so the holder is always another package's and there is no "Open".
- A fresh identifier is created exactly as before: the draft save with `mode: 'draft'`, `packageId`, `ifNoneMatch: '*'`, `surface: 'studio'`. The pin still refuses a draft that lands between the check and the save.
- **Strings** (`@object-ui/i18n`, `studio` namespace, `en` and `zh`): five refusal rows (`engine.studio.auto.createTaken`, `…auto.createTakenElsewhere`, `…app.createTaken`, `…data.createTaken`, `…data.createTakenElsewhere`); `engine.studio.access.openExisting` becomes the shared `engine.studio.create.openExisting`; `engine.studio.data.idExists`, which the new refusal replaces, is removed.
- One root changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch. No `packages/spec/**`, no server change, no metadata key.

## Why

The card's order was to measure each create first. Measured at the metadata door (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.saveMetaItem`, the in-memory engine double of `protocol.served-content-hash.test.ts`, both packages installed in the registry): publish an item, then save a draft of the same name with `parentVersion: null` (the REST door's `If-None-Match: *`) and `mode: 'draft'`, as each create does.

| type | published in | draft saved from | result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| flow | same package | `com.acme.app` | written: active row "Live" + draft row "Blank" |
| flow | other package | `com.acme.app` | written: active row (other) + draft row (acme) |
| app | same / other package | `com.acme.app` | written over it, both cases |
| object | same / other package | `com.acme.app` | written over it, both cases |
| permission (control, #26836) | same / other package | `com.acme.app` | written over it, both cases |

So no create was already safe at the door. The Data create was safe only for an object on its own rail (same package), which it already refused; the other two checked nothing. The probe was a scratch test, not committed.

## Tests

`StudioDesignSurface.createTaken-26917.test.tsx`, eight cases on the real `AutomationsPillar`, `DataPillar` and `StudioDesignSurface` (for Create app), over a client double that keeps published and draft rows per package, writes a draft over a published row the way the door does, and refuses the pin over a draft row:

- flow on this package's rail: refused, `save` never called, no draft row, the published body unchanged, the sentence names it, and "Open" opens it (its draft read follows);
- flow another package holds: refused, nothing written, body unchanged, no "Open";
- flow, fresh identifier: saved with the four options above;
- object another package holds (`acme_ticket`): refused, nothing written, body unchanged, no "Open";
- object on this package's rail: refused, nothing written, "Open" opens it;
- object, fresh identifier: saved with the four options;
- app another package holds: refused, nothing written, body unchanged, no "Open";
- app, fresh identifier: saved with the four options.

## Acceptance notes

- **Race window, as on Access:** an item published (or created in another package) between the create's two reads and its save is not refused by the pin; a draft that lands there still is. Closing it for every client would need the door's draft-mode pin to judge every lifecycle, a spec and server change the seat ruled out on #26836 (answer A).
- **Create app's sentence names no package.** Create app is shown only when the package has no app, so "this package already has one" cannot occur; the one sentence says an app holds the identifier.
- The object create's rail arm keeps its no-read fast path: an identifier on the rail is refused before the two reads.

## Verification

All at head `efc675b9` (this branch merged `origin/main` `b1b153a3`, which brought #26927's held-edit question on New), in a worktree, every build and test under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

<details><summary>New tests, ablation, type-check, lint and nearby suites</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` on the new file, the Access file (#26836) and #26927's three `held*Create-26845` files: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 25 passed (25)`.
- Ablation (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `  if (!publishedRow && !draftRow) return null;` replaced by `  if (true || (!publishedRow && !draftRow)) return null;`, anchor x1 to x0) over the new file and the Access file: `Tests 7 failed | 10 passed (17)`, exactly the seven refusals that go through `findTakenIdentifier` (three Access, two flow, object-elsewhere, app); the object-on-rail case stays green because it is refused by the rail arm before the read. Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` (app-shell's covers the test file).
- eslint on the two app-shell files and the two catalogues: 0 errors; `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` carries the same 14 warnings as on `origin/main`.
- Narrowed suites: every app-shell test file naming `AutomationsPillar`, `DataPillar`, `AccessPillar`, `StudioDesignSurface` or an `engine.studio.(auto|data|app|access|create).` key (178 files), plus all of `packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 267 passed (267)`, `Tests 2780 passed | 13 skipped (2793)`. CI's Test UI runs the rest of app-shell.
- `pnpm run check:i18n-designer-parity` (from `ui/`): "Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders." `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived dispatch gates (34/34)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 34 commands (the same list before and after the merge of main); every one exited 0 at `efc675b9`, the PR-body gates (`check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`) against this body through `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`, and `check-partof-closing-keyword` with `PR_BODY`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: `Test Files 178 passed | 2 skipped (180)`, `Tests 5065 passed | 2 skipped (5067)`.
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt`: `0 raw tsc error(s) total, none above its recorded number`.

</details>

Dogfood battery: not run, no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
